name: gpuixui
description: Shadcn registry for GPUIxUI, the native UI component library for GPUix and React. Each item installs a component's source files. These are GPUix native components: the files render through GPUix's reconciler against `@gpuix/react`, not the DOM, and need the per-platform `@gpuix/native` binding. The `@gpuixui/*` sibling packages are workspace-only today, so add them from the repository before the copied files run.
